sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Collect all 5 current green blocks
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
green_blocks = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks: {len(green_blocks)}")

click_positions = []
for gb in green_blocks:
    boundary = gb['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
    cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
    center_row = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
    center_col = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
    click_positions.append((center_row, center_col))
    print(f"  Click: row={center_row}, col={center_col}")

mouse_actions = [{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c} for r, c in click_positions]
result = action(mouse_actions)
print(f"\nAfter collecting 5: level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}, done={result.get('done')}")

# Check state
seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
green2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
wall2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'S']
print(f"Green remaining: {len(green2)}")
if wall2:
    print(f"Wall pixels: {wall2[0]['pixels']}")
else:
    print("No wall!")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
